result.topic_en: Euler collects the terms of the differential variation of ∫Z dx when Z involves nested integrals: he introduces V = ∫L dx and T = ∫Lv dx (both chosen to vanish at x = a) and the abbreviations (N), (P), (Q), (R), and so reduces the variation to the standard form. Two corollaries re-express Vv − T as ∫𝔏V dx = 𝔙.
result.transcription:
128 \qquad DE METHODO

Ponamus ergo porro $\int L\,dx = V$ et $\int L v\,dx = T$, eritque
$\int L\,dx\,\delta\Phi = T\int dx(\mathfrak{n}\delta y + \mathfrak{p}\delta p + \mathfrak{q}\delta q + \mathfrak{r}\delta r + \text{etc.})$
$-\int T\,dx(\mathfrak{n}\delta y + \mathfrak{p}\delta p + \mathfrak{q}\delta q + \mathfrak{r}\delta r + \text{etc.})$
$+V\int dx\,\delta y(\mathfrak{N} - v\mathfrak{n}) + V\int dx\,\delta p(\mathfrak{P} - v\mathfrak{p}) + V\int dx\,\delta q(\mathfrak{Q} - v\mathfrak{q})$ etc.
$-\int V\,dx\,\delta y(\mathfrak{N} - v\mathfrak{n}) - \int V\,dx\,\delta p(\mathfrak{P} - v\mathfrak{p}) - \int V\,dx\,\delta q(\mathfrak{Q} - v\mathfrak{q})$ etc.
His igitur omnibus colligendis prodibit variatio differentialis quaesita
$\delta\int Z\,dx = T\int dx(\mathfrak{n}\delta y + \mathfrak{p}\delta p + \mathfrak{q}\delta q + \mathfrak{r}\delta r + \text{etc.})$
$+V\int dx\,\delta y(\mathfrak{N} - v\mathfrak{n}) + V\int dx\,\delta p(\mathfrak{P} - v\mathfrak{p})$
$+V\int dx\,\delta q(\mathfrak{Q} - v\mathfrak{q})$ etc.
$+\int dx\,\delta y(N - V\mathfrak{N} + Vv\mathfrak{n} - T\mathfrak{n})$
$+\int dx\,\delta p(P - V\mathfrak{P} + Vv\mathfrak{p} - T\mathfrak{p})$
$+\int dx\,\delta q(Q - V\mathfrak{Q} + Vv\mathfrak{q} - T\mathfrak{q})$
etc.
quae cum ad terminum usque $x = a$ extendi debeat, ponamus integralia $\int L\,dx = V$, et $\int L\,dx\int\mathfrak{L}\,dx = T$, quandoquidem determinatio integrationis nostro arbitrio relinquitur, ita capi, ut evanescant, posito $x = a$; quo nostra expressio facilior reddatur. Deinde vero ponamus brevitatis gratia:
$N - V\mathfrak{N} + (Vv - T)\mathfrak{n} = (N)$
$P - V\mathfrak{P} + (Vv - T)\mathfrak{p} = (P)$
$Q - V\mathfrak{Q} + (Vv - T)\mathfrak{q} = (Q)$
$R - V\mathfrak{R} + (Vv - T)\mathfrak{r} = (R)$
etc.
existente

MAXIMORUM ET MINIMORUM. \qquad 129

existente, ut assumsimus, $v = \int\mathfrak{L}\,dx$, atque variatio differentialis quaesita reducetur ad hanc formam:
$\delta\int Z\,dx = \int dx\,\delta y\left((N) - \frac{d(P)}{dx} + \frac{dd(Q)}{dx^2} - \frac{d^3(R)}{dx^3} + \text{etc.}\right)$
$+\delta y\left((P) - \frac{d(Q)}{dx} + \frac{dd(R)}{dx^2} - \text{etc.}\right)$
$+\frac{d\delta y}{dx}\left((Q) - \frac{d(R)}{dx} + \text{etc.}\right)$
$+\frac{dd\delta y}{dx^2}\left((R) - \text{etc.}\right)$ etc.

Coroll. 1.

Cum sit $v = \int\mathfrak{L}\,dx$, erit $Vv = \int L\,dx\cdot\int\mathfrak{L}\,dx$ et $Vv - T = \int L\,dx\cdot\int\mathfrak{L}\,dx - \int L\,dx\int\mathfrak{L}\,dx = \int\mathfrak{L}\,dx\int L\,dx$. Quia autem per determinationes assumtas expressio $Vv - T$ evanescit, posito $x = a$, si ponamus $\int L\,dx = V$ et $\int\mathfrak{L}V\,dx = \mathfrak{V}$, ambo haec integralia ita capi oportet, ut evanescant, posito $x = a$.

Coroll. 2.

His igitur formulis $\int L\,dx = V$, et $\int\mathfrak{L}V\,dx = \mathfrak{V}$, in computum introductis, ponendum erit:
$N - V\mathfrak{N} + \mathfrak{V}\mathfrak{n} = (N)$
$P - V\mathfrak{P} + \mathfrak{V}\mathfrak{p} = (P)$
$Q - V\mathfrak{Q} + \mathfrak{V}\mathfrak{q} = (Q)$
$R - V\mathfrak{R} + \mathfrak{V}\mathfrak{r} = (R)$
etc.
et variatio differentialis per litteras (N), (P), (Q) etc. perinde exprimetur, ac supra casu primo per litteras N, P, Q etc. erat definita.

Tom. X. Nov. Comm. \qquad R \qquad Coroll.

items.quote: Quia autem per determinationes assumtas expressio $Vv - T$ evanescit, posito $x = a$, si ponamus $\int L\,dx = V$ et $\int\mathfrak{L}V\,dx = \mathfrak{V}$, ambo haec integralia ita capi oportet, ut evanescant, posito $x = a$.
items.english: But since, by the assumed determinations, the expression Vv − T vanishes when x = a, if we set ∫L dx = V and ∫𝔏V dx = 𝔙, both these integrals must be taken so that they vanish when x = a.

items.quote: et variatio differentialis per litteras (N), (P), (Q) etc. perinde exprimetur, ac supra casu primo per litteras N, P, Q etc. erat definita.
items.english: and the differential variation will be expressed through the letters (N), (P), (Q) etc. in just the same way as it was defined above, in the first case, through the letters N, P, Q etc.
